cause.overwrite: Builder used Map.set(key, singleEntry), so later Lexique rows replace earlier rows.
cause.identityCollision: The key used accent-folded norm(form), merging distinct exact spellings such as mur/mûr before lookup.
cause.sourceGap: Some ordinary noun senses (basse instrument, enceinte speaker, portable phone) are absent from the current pronunciation mirror for those exact graphies, so preserving Lexique rows alone cannot recover them.
